description: Eval prompts for the protein-ligand docking visualization skill. Each prompt simulates a real user request a docking-savvy researcher would type into the VMD AI panel. The grader checks for the presence of expected Tcl/matplotlib idioms and rendering steps in the agent transcript.

evals.prompt: I have a receptor.pdb and vina_out.pdb with 9 docked poses from AutoDock Vina. Render a publication-quality figure of the top pose: cartoon receptor in light gray, binding-pocket residues as licorice, ligand as licorice colored by atom type, white background, orthographic. Save the snapshot.
expected_assertions: Loads receptor with mol new ... type pdbqt
Loads pose file with mol new and references numframes
Drops or resets existing representations before adding new ones
Sets display projection Orthographic
Sets background to white via color Display Background white
Adds NewCartoon representation for protein
Computes pocket residues using measure contacts (cross-molecule selection)
Adds Licorice rep with mol color Name for the ligand
Calls mol drawframes to limit to a specific pose
Calls render snapshot or render TachyonInternal
Calls capture_vmd_snapshot to verify

evals.prompt: Show the top Vina pose prominently and overlay the other 8 poses as faded thin sticks so I can see the spread. Same receptor and pose file as before. White background, orthographic.
expected_assertions: Reads numframes to determine pose count
Adds a thick Licorice rep for pose 0
Adds a thinner Licorice rep with Transparent material for poses 1..N-1
Uses mol drawframes with frame list {0} for the top pose
Uses mol drawframes with the remaining frame list for alternates
Uses ColorID-based color for the alternate-pose rep (visual distinction from top pose)
Captures snapshot to verify overlay

evals.prompt: Color all 9 docked poses by their Vina affinity score and render as a single VMD scene. Use a perceptually uniform colormap (BWR or BlueRed). Annotate the color scale range with the actual min and max scores from the Vina output.
expected_assertions: Parses Vina REMARK lines to extract per-pose affinities
Writes scores into the User column of every frame via $sel set user
Uses mol color User for the ensemble rep
Calls mol scaleminmax with the actual score range (negative numbers, e.g. -12 to -4)
Calls mol colupdate to refresh the per-frame color
Captures snapshot for verification
Reports the min/max scores back to the user in text

evals.prompt: Make a heatmap showing which pocket residues each of the 9 docked poses contacts (within 4 A). Y-axis poses, X-axis residue IDs sorted, white-to-red colormap. Save as both PNG and SVG with publication formatting.
expected_assertions: Iterates over poses calling measure contacts with cutoff 4.0
Maps contacted atom indices back to unique resids
Builds a binary contact matrix (poses x residues)
Writes matrix to a .dat or .npy file consumable by Python
Writes a matplotlib script using Agg backend
Uses imshow with YlOrRd or equivalent colormap
Sets x-tick labels to residue IDs (rotated)
Sets axis labels with units / clear names
Saves both PNG (300 DPI) and SVG outputs

evals.prompt: Compute the all-vs-all heavy-atom RMSD matrix across all 9 docked poses and plot it as a heatmap. I want to see if the poses cluster into distinct binding modes.
expected_assertions: Uses an atomselect with 'noh' to ignore hydrogens
Iterates with nested frame loops to compute pairwise RMSD
Calls measure rmsd with two selections that differ only in the frame they reference
Writes the NxN matrix to a data file
Plots a heatmap with imshow using viridis or comparable colormap
Adds a colorbar labeled 'RMSD (Å)'
Saves both PNG and SVG outputs

evals.prompt: Render the docked complex with a semi-transparent receptor surface so I can see the cavity around the ligand. Restrict the surface to residues within 8 A of the ligand to keep render times reasonable. Use TachyonInternal for the final image.
expected_assertions: Computes pocket residues via measure contacts
Adds a Surf or QuickSurf rep restricted to pocket residues
Sets material to Transparent on the surface rep
Uses TachyonInternal renderer instead of plain render snapshot
Captures snapshot afterwards

evals.prompt: Plot Vina affinity vs pose rank as a bar chart. The top pose's score should be highlighted with a horizontal dashed line. Use the publication style: Arial, single column, colorblind-safe palette.
expected_assertions: Parses Vina scores from the PDBQT REMARK lines
Writes a python script using matplotlib with Agg backend
Uses ax.bar(ranks, scores)
Adds ax.axhline for the top score with a dashed linestyle
Inverts y-axis or uses absolute values so 'better' reads upward
Sets axis labels with units (kcal/mol)
Saves both PNG and SVG with bbox_inches='tight'
